text:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — partner asks to onboard APAC-south2 with 3 SKU variants (g6, g6-x, g6-rt). Need quota, KMS, marketplace listing + SI handoff. Timeline target: 6 weeks.
Miguel Santos: +1 on the SKUs. Do we know expected qps/peak? that affects reserved capacity.
Asha Patel: Partner estimates 600 qps avg, 1.8k peak for first 3 months. We should plan burst and autoscale.
Priya Kapoor: Ops note — if we do g6-rt (RT infer), need NVLink config and custom kernel 2.3. That adds ~5 days to infra prep.
Tom Reynolds: From partner side: they want joint announcement aligned with marketplace go-live. Legal needs 2 weeks for copy + logos. Can marketing get a draft? @Lena Ortiz can you coordinate?
Lena Ortiz: I can take marketing lead. Will gather logos + partner-approved copy. Need confirmation of go-live date by EOD Friday.
EcosysBot: marketplace-checklist v2.4 triggered: required items = [QuotaRequest, KMS onboarding, SKU-metadata, SI-integration doc, Legal approval]. See https://redwood.ai/internal/marketplace/onboard for templates.
Miguel Santos: I'll start the quota request. Suggest numbers: initial reserve 8 GPUs (g6), 4 GPUs (g6-x), 2 GPUs (g6-rt) with auto-burst to 20 total. Anyone object?
Priya Kapoor: Sounds reasonable. Ops prefers staging pool mirror at 20% of capacity for replay tests.
Asha Patel: ok lock that. Miguel, can you submit quota with that and tag infra-quotas?
Miguel Santos: On it. Submitting now:
```
Project: partner-apac-south2
SKUs: g6:8,g6-x:4,g6-rt:2
BurstCap:20
Purpose: marketplace onboarding + SI pilot
Owner: miguel@redwood.com
```
Miguel Santos: filed ticket #Q-11289. ETA for approval depends on cloud partner (usually 3-7 biz days).
Tom Reynolds: SI integration — note partner's SI needs access to staging VPC and sample model artifacts. Priya, what's the process for onboarding SIs?
Priya Kapoor: We have an SI playbook. Steps: 1) NDAs in place, 2) create service account + least-priv role, 3) ephemeral VPC access (2-week TTL), 4) logging hooks. I'll create infra runbook and share link.
Asha Patel: Legal + security check for SI access — @Lena please loop in Legal if not already.
Lena Ortiz: Looping legal now. Also will request brand guidances from partner.
EcosysBot: kms-onboard workflow started. Required: CMK id, HSM policy, Key rotation window. Reply with CMK id to continue.
Miguel Santos: Partner provided CMK placeholder: projects/partnerX/locations/global/keyRings/ring1/cryptoKeys/km-01 — validating with cloud provider.
Priya Kapoor: If KMS in partner project, we need cross-project roles. Expect a 2-3 day lead time.
Asha Patel: Can we overlap KMS and quota approvals to hit 6-week target?
Miguel Santos: Yes, doing parallel. Quota ticket filed, kms validation in progress, infra prep will start once quota accepted.
Tom Reynolds: Marketing timeline: draft joint blog by week 4, partner approvals week 5, press week 6. Legal ok with that?
Lena Ortiz: Will confirm but 2-week legal turnaround is optimistic. We'll aim to compress approvals by providing boilerplate.
Asha Patel: Action items: Miguel -> follow quota + kms (ticket Q-11289). Priya -> SI runbook + staging pool config. Lena -> marketing draft + legal loop. Tom -> confirm partner announcement window.
Miguel Santos: Updating Q-11289 with KMS CMK and infra notes. Ping me for any spec changes.
Priya Kapoor: I'll post runbook link when done: https://redwood.ai/internal/runbooks/si-onboard-apac-south2 (draft)
Lena Ortiz: Will share marketing brief by Tue COB.
Tom Reynolds: Partner pref would be last week of month. I'll flag that in partner channel and try to get earlier legal signoff.
Asha Patel: Thanks team. Small ask — can we include a fallback model variant for low-capacity window? e.g., 2x quantized smaller model in marketplace listing. Helps reliability.
Miguel Santos: agree. I'll add model variant sku (g6-q) to the metadata as fallback.
EcosysBot: checklist update: [QuotaRequest:done, KMS:onhold->validating, SKU-metadata:in-progress, SI-doc:in-progress, Legal:pending].
Lena Ortiz: Noted. I'll request partner copy that mentions "limited availability" to be safe.
Priya Kapoor: Ops will schedule maintenance window in week 5 for kernel changes. ETA: 4 hours.
Asha Patel: Final Qs before I close: any blockers on compliance or certs?
Miguel Santos: none flagged yet. Cloud partner may require additional SCC or SOC proof — I'll raise if needed.
Tom Reynolds: Partner ok with limited availability label. Also they asked for co-branded webinar after 6 weeks. We'll plan that offline.
Asha Patel: Great. I'll update project tracker and send weekly status in this thread. Thanks :thumbsup:
Miguel Santos: thanks all :rocket:
Lena Ortiz: thanks!
Priya Kapoor: +1
EcosysBot: ticket Q-11289 status change -> APPROVAL_PENDING on cloud side.
